overview: The broadcast examined the 1980 Depositors Trust bank burglary in Medford planned by corrupt police officers, followed by the Bre-X mining fraud orchestrated in Indonesia.

items.title: Depositors Trust Burglary
items.summary: Commentators detailed the 1980 Memorial Day weekend burglary of Depositors Trust in Medford led by Police Captain Jerry Clemente, which resulted in the theft of $10 million and ended with convictions after coconspirators confessed.

items.title: Bre-X Mining Fraud
items.summary: The broadcast documented how geologist Michael de Guzman faked a massive Indonesian gold deposit by salting core samples to inflate Bre-X stock before the fraud unraveled and he disappeared.
